summary.intent: Fix two CI failures: intermittent E2E test failures in full-workflow and sharing-workflow specs, and a Grafana Cloud provisioning failure in the staging pipeline.
summary.outcome: The E2E race condition in FileList.tsx was fixed (reversed dedup logic, then improved to ID-based filtering after PR review), verified locally, and merged to main via PR #414. The Grafana issue was identified as a configuration problem (wrong stack URL) requiring manual action, not a code fix.

repo: Fresh git worktrees do not inherit .env files — they must be copied manually from the main repo checkout (e.g. `cp ../cipher-box/apps/web/.env apps/web/.env`).
The web dev server proxies /api to localhost:3000 by default; set VITE_API_URL to the staging API URL to test web-only changes against staging without running a local API.
The Grafana Cloud provisioning job hits https://cipherbox.grafana.net/api/health — if this returns 404, the GRAFANA_URL GitHub environment variable is stale or the stack was deprovisioned.

CodeRabbit and GitHub Copilot both reviewed PR #414 and flagged the same issue: name-based upload dedup could hide in-progress uploads with duplicate filenames. ID-based filtering is the correct approach.

code.finding: Upload dedup filter originally removed real file rows when their name matched a completing upload entry during the 1-second green flash. Fixed by (1) reversing the filter direction — hide upload rows when real files exist — then (2) switching to ID-based filtering (`completeUploadIds` Set) to avoid false matches on duplicate filenames.

workflow: For web-only E2E fixes, run the web dev server locally pointed at the staging API (VITE_API_URL=<staging>) — no local API server needed. This avoids the CORS/auth issues that appear when mixing origins.
Playwright's webServer config may auto-start a local API server, which can conflict with an already-running process on port 3000 and cause confusing test failures.
When a fix is client-side only, tests against staging-deployed code won't validate the fix — must run the local dev server with the fix applied.
After implementing PR review fixes, use `gh api graphql` to resolve threads and `gh api repos/.../pulls/.../comments` with `--field in_reply_to=<int>` (not `-f`) to reply.
The .learnings/ directory is the project's convention for capturing debugging workflows and setup recipes — add new files there when a novel class of problem is solved.

friction: Multiple failed attempts to run E2E tests before realising the correct setup: local web dev server pointed at staging API, no local API required for a web-only fix.
Web3Auth fails to initialise when the app origin is localhost but the API is on a different domain — login button never renders, causing tests to fail at the auth step.
Fresh worktree had no .env files, causing both API and web dev server to exit immediately; required manual copy from the main repo checkout.
Port 3000 conflict: the main repo's API server was already running, causing the worktree API server to fail silently.
Playwright's webServer auto-start behaviour started a local API server unexpectedly, interfering with the staging-API test run and causing the session-reload test (test 17) to fail locally.
open_items: full-workflow test 17 ('Page reload preserves session') fails locally when web is pointed at staging API — likely a pre-existing auth session timeout issue, not related to the upload fix. Needs investigation.

Grafana Cloud provisioning failure requires manual action: verify the correct stack URL at grafana.com, update GRAFANA_URL in the GitHub staging environment, and confirm GRAFANA_API_KEY is still valid. Alternatively, add `continue-on-error: true` to the provision-dashboard job to unblock deploys.
